**Experimental mod only for testing!**

Main feature of this mod is ability to use **box32**. 
If **WoW64** mode is enabled, WoW64 Wine is used (default).
If **WoW64** mode is disabled, the regular bi-arch Wine is used with the **box32** feature. For now, some x86 OpenGL games work in **box32** mode with higher performance than in WoW64 mode.

- Built-in custom **frame generation** (_Screen effects -> Frame generation_).
- Support of **Russian** input (Unicode) from the on-screen keyboard.
- **Freedreno** OpenGL driver, **LLVMPipe** driver.
- Optional **Lorie X-server**.
- **Old VirGL** test server with better compatibility.

It is recommended to _disable WoW64_ mode with **VirGL** for better performance.

**Changes:**
- Added **vkBasalt** sharpness effects for shortcuts (from Winlator Bionic).
- Upgraded **Frame generation**: improved _motion estimation_, added _FPS multiplier_ (x2, x3, x4), added _Motion scale_, _Blending_ and _Post-processing_ adjustments, added _Engine_ options (DIS, QCOM, GLES).

releases.name: ares v148
releases.body:
ares v148 has now been released.

This release includes big improvements to a number of ares cores. Highlights include rewrites to the N64 CPU & RSP JITs resulting in significant performance gains across the N64 library, additional implementation & accuracy improvements to the PlayStation core, fixes to the GBA core, and support for the Famicom data recorder & Dendy. 

Additionally, there have been many updates to the core ares application across all platforms. Per-core input configuration has been added, updated video, audio, & input drivers are available, bug fixes, additional options have been added, and core dependencies have been updated. 

Since v147, 20 contributors have created 300 commits to the ares codebase.

As always, if you wish to see the full changelog in a per-commit format along with their authors, you can do so on GitHub [here](https://github.com/ares-emulator/ares/compare/v147...v148).

ares v145 has now been released.

This release contains hefty improvements to a number of ares components. Highlights include Real Time Clock support for the Game Boy Advance, improvements to the experimental PlayStation core, Sega SC-3000 support, important fixes to the Game Boy Color, as well as core improvements to the ares application itself that should improve performance and responsiveness.

Since v144, 8 contributors have created 90 commits to the ares codebase.

As always, if you wish to see the full changelog in a per-commit format along with their authors, you can do so on GitHub [here](https://github.com/ares-emulator/ares/compare/v144...v145).

**ARM7TDMI (Game Boy Advance CPU, ST018 Super Famicom coprocessor)**

- Implemented many undocumented instruction encodings
- Implemented invalid CPSR modes
- Added support for MRC, MCR, and CDP coprocessor instructions
- Allowed misalignment of the program counter in ARM mode

**Nintendo - Game Boy Color**

- Improved HDMA and GDMA timings (fixes some major graphical bugs)

**Nintendo - Game Boy Advance**

- Added support for the Real Time Clock
- Re-introduced optional Game Boy Player support

## NieR:Automata Android Recomp v0.2.7

### Español
- **Soporte multi-región y fix de modelos negros (PR #26 / PR #27):** Resolución automática `ADRP+LDR` para USA y Asia 1.0.3 (presenter y resolución dinámica mínima `0.6`) y firma ampliada de 8 instrucciones en `mesh_draw_hook` para evitar falsos matches y modelos/naves en negro.
- **Corrección de reflejos/cubemaps negros:** Añadido `VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT` en texturas `2D_ARRAY` cuadradas de `6n` capas.
- **Optimizaciones de rendimiento NVN:** Salida rápida con `memcmp` + comparación SIMD NEON ARM64 en write-backs (`apply_write_back`), pool de snapshots (`g_before_pool`) y pool de buffers spill (`g_staging_pool`) para reducir pausas de CPU y asignaciones de memoria por frame.
- **Fix Android 10 (API 29) y diagonales en mando:** Guard de `InsetsController` para evitar crashes al iniciar en Android 10 y zona muerta radial 2D para sticks físicos.

---

### English
- **Multi-region hooks & black models fix (PR #26 / PR #27):** Automatic `ADRP+LDR` slot resolution across USA and Asia 1.0.3 builds (presenter & dynamic-res floor `0.6`) plus expanded 8-instruction `mesh_draw_hook` signature to prevent black 3D models/ships.

- 整合声音、对白、亮度、纹理、植被显示与运行时内存修复，混音器默认启用。
- 修正 Mali 顶点整数属性与着色器输入类型匹配，RG477M 人物已可正常显示。

RG477M / MT6897 / Mali-G615 / Android 14 已验证安装、原版 Ver1.07 标题、声音恢复、人物显示、开场至户外与城镇流程、虚拟手柄和原游戏存档缩略图。图形组件测试 64 项中 63 通过、1 项缺私有输入跳过，运行时 8 项通过。

releases.body:
* Fixed GB, GBC and GBA games running slow on PAL (576i) 50Hz output
* Fixed JIT IRQ latency bug causing graphical artifacts
* **Restored the original controls of the games with special Wii controls** (Zelda, Mario, Metroid, Ninja Turtles, Mortal Kombat, Star Wars, Harry Potter, Medal of Honor, Boktai, The Lord of the Rings, Castlevania and the rest). releases.body:
Changes since the latest beta release:
- Fixed two UI issues (#843, #846)
- Fixed a bug in the CBM file system implementation (#853)
- Fixed a bug in the drive idle logic (#854)
- Fixed three drive-related VICE tests (#668, #674, #675)

Core and API

* Public API: The API now has as new shape. There are async counterparts (…Async) for state-changing calls, set is now setAsync, there is a new MemoryDebugger API, more getters, and suspend/resume coverage across the API.
* Threading: The command queue and message queue are now std::deque-based. Messages can carry exceptions. AudioPort is thread-safe. Cmd::CALL, TRACK_ON and TRACK_OFF are new.
* Messages: Msg::CONFIG is sent for every option change. ROM_LOADED, RSH_DONE and CONFIG_ERROR are new.
* RetroShell: It has the new architecture from vAmiga, with multiple shells and a single console per shell.
* Workspaces: A screenshot is now saved inside saveWorkspace().
* X-Ray: GPU X-Ray support is added, with a new XRAY_COMPOSITOR option.
* Shared libraries: utlib and rvlib were merged with the versions shared with vAmiga and Silicium.
* Cleanup: Header, include and namespace cleanups, plus removal of orphaned files.

Fixes

* Drive::isIdle() is fixed (#854).

This maintenance release primarily addresses issue #851, which prevented the app from running on the upcoming macOS 27 Golden Gate. It also includes internal code changes required to make the core compatible with the architecture of the upcoming Silicium emulator.
Removing beta status, as no significant bugs have been reported for some time.

## Refactoring

This beta release introduces substantial changes to the underlying code base. As part of the development of the RetroVault app, a new **RetroVault** library has been created. This library is now responsible for managing:

- File systems  
- Devices  
- All supported image formats  

RetroVault is designed as a standalone library and is also used in the latest version of vAmiga for the same purpose.

In addition, the new **utlib** library has been introduced. All utility functions previously embedded in vAmiga and VirtualC64 have been refactored into this more powerful shared library. This makes it easier for me to share common functionality among the different emulators. 

## Enhancements

- The disassembler now supports symbol files (#837)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a crash in the file system importer when importing excessively large folders (#841)  
- Fixed a bug in the VIC inspector that prevented selecting individual sprites in Tahoe (#840)

releases.name: CosmoU 0.13.0
releases.body:
## ✨ A calmer, clearer CosmoU

CosmoU 0.13 reworks the whole interface. All the features are still there, just sorted better, so every window and every theme feels like one product: easy to understand on the first start, calm with a big library, readable from the sofa.

## What changed

- **Play is always the strongest button** – in Covers, Grid, the Wii U Look and the game details. Details and the other actions are quieter.
- **Grid** – a calm banner: the cover sharp in front of its own softly blurred colours, instead of a giant pixelated picture.
- **Game details** – a smaller cover, Play first, *Add to favorites* as a quiet toggle, one line instead of four empty statistics before the first play, the tools in one row, save data and updates as simple rows.
- **Settings** – a calmer category bar (only the open category is in colour), a bigger search with its shortcut (Ctrl F / ⌘F).
- **Quick Menu** – your games first, then three clear groups: **Look**, **Sound** and **System**.
- **Theme gallery** – big cards with a preview picture of every theme.
- **Empty screens lead somewhere** – *Clear search*, *Show the library*, or the folder button of the console you're looking at.

releases.name: Xenoblade 3 port v0.4.0
releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

Install the APK over the previous version (your settings and saves stay) or follow the [README](https://github.com/IamWilmar/xenoblade3-recomp#install-and-first-run) for a first install.

Ahora el juego va en modo inmersivo: las dos barras se ocultan y deslizando desde un borde salen un momento. Comprobado en la Flip 2.

# reNut Android 0.4.0

An experimental Android port of **Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts** (Xbox 360), built from a static recompilation of the game.

> **Heads up:** this is a vibe-coded port. Expect bugs, rough edges and uneven compatibility across devices.

## Features

- **Local multiplayer** for two players: connect a second gamepad and it joins as player 2.
- **No GPU command-stream emulation.** The game's Direct3D calls are translated straight into Vulkan through Plume, the same renderer layer UnleashedRecomp uses, with shaders recompiled ahead of time. Some Xbox 360 GPU behaviour (resolves, texture formats, tessellation, memexport) is still emulated on the host.
- **In-app achievements** section.
- **Graphics options** to trade quality for performance:
  - internal resolution
  - texture resolution
  - shadow resolution
- **Adrenotools driver support**, a bundled Turnip driver and Turnip tuning options.
- **Save import and export.**

## Performance

On a Galaxy S23 Ultra the game runs above 30 FPS at the original graphics settings. Other devices have not been tested, so your results will vary. If it runs slowly, lower the internal, texture and shadow resolution.

# BluBox 360 0.16.3 public alpha

BluBox 360 0.16.3 focuses on easier updating and safer sustained performance on Android handhelds such as the AYN Thor.

## Check for updates

- Added a **Check for updates** button under **Settings > App**.
- Automatic update checks keep the existing 15-minute cooldown.
- A manual check runs immediately and ignores the automatic cooldown.
- Manual checks now confirm when BluBox is already up to date.
- Manual checks show an error message if GitHub cannot be reached instead of silently closing.

## Smart Heat Guard

- Low Heat Mode remains available and still avoids maximum-clock requests.
- BluBox now checks Android thermal status and thermal headroom when a game launches.

- A 60 FPS target can be reduced to a 30 FPS safety ceiling when the device is already approaching thermal throttling.
- Shader creation is reduced to one worker under thermal pressure to lower sustained CPU load.
- Fable II keeps its existing 24 FPS safety ceiling.
- The existing severe-heat protection remains enabled during gameplay.

releases.name: openMSX 22.0
releases.body:
Release Notes for openMSX 22.0 (2026-10-28)
===========================================

Thanks to many contributors (who make good use of modern AI tools), we
have a very long list of changes again. Major features are found in the
debugger GUI, with a new Raster Beam Viewer and Tracer functionality. We also
have the Quick Setup Editor, for one-window access to all major setup
settings.

Then AI hit us with dozens of Pull Requests with new and improved
functionality... Not all purely AI-generated, but also using AI to analyse
bulk measurements. This led to many VDP accuracy improvements and emulation of
new devices like plotters, Panasonic FS-JH1 Joy Handle steering wheel (that
came with Konami's A1 Spirit), light guns, Franky, Makoto, SD Mapper V1 and
SM-X WiFi. There's even a synthetic TCP/IP UNAPI device to be able to try out
network programs in openMSX.

And many, many more things...

Special thanks to all the contributors of this release who are not in the core
team! Keep those pull requests coming!

Here's the list with all highlights and details:

MSX device support:
- fixed Yamanooto SCC register visibility

releases.name: openMSX 21.0
releases.body:
openMSX 21.0 has many improvements on the new GUI introduced in openMSX 20.0 (especially the debugger) and several other smaller features. It also introduces the "setups" concept, which enables you to define an MSX setup (e.g. a Philips VG 8020 with an external disk drive and a joystick, data recorder and printer connected). These can be created, loaded, and automatically started. They can also be saved automatically when you exit.

Furthermore, flash chip emulation has become a lot more accurate, thanks to Laurens Holst.

releases.name: openMSX 20.0
releases.body:
openMSX 20.0—Autumn Spring—is a major release, in which we introduce the new Graphical User Interface, replacing the OSD menu. A faster and more powerful debugger is now included in openMSX itself. Configuration for MSX joystick/JoyMega has been improved drastically using the new GUI. If you still want to use Catapult, you can use the Catapult release that came with openMSX 19.0. Please [read the release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openMSX/openMSX/RELEASE_20_0/doc/release-notes.txt) for details of the openMSX changes.

As always, special thanks to all the contributors of this release who are not in the core team! Keep these pull requests coming!

Please note that as of now, a system with OpenGL 2 support is required to run openMSX.

releases.name: openMSX 19.1
releases.body:
openMSX 19.1—Reflection—is a bug fix release for openMSX 19.0, as we found some rather nasty issues after releasing, mostly that LaserDisc support was broken. No new Catapult will be released, as it has no changes.  Please [read the release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openMSX/openMSX/RELEASE_19_1/doc/release-notes.txt) for details of the openMSX changes.

Thanks for those who gave us the feedback so that we found out about these issues.

Please note that this will be the last openMSX release that supports systems without OpenGL 2 or higher.

# Heroes V for Android 0.8.2-dev

Includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1, and Tribes of the East 3.1. Requires Android 8.0 or later, an ARM64 device, and the original PC game files. Android version code **15**.

## Startup and launcher

- Added **3D main menu** and **Fast main menu** options. Turn off the 3D background to use a solid color, or enable fast startup to use the menu while the 3D scene loads between frames. Both options take effect on the next launch.
- Selecting a parent folder containing GOG Gold and Tribes of the East can set up all three editions in one step. The launcher keeps existing working game paths.
- ZIP imports now check the MD5 when the checksum is included in the archive filename and report mismatches.
- The launcher adapts to wide windows with a two-column layout and accepts custom Vulkan drivers in ZIP or `.so` format.
- On Xiaomi HyperOS, the launcher offers a shortcut to Game Turbo before autostart. The tip can be dismissed and reopened from About.

## Touch controls and interface

- Interface scale is now a dropdown from **50% to 200%** in **25%** steps. A value saved by the old slider stays in effect until you select a new value.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.8-dev
releases.body:
Speeds up AI turns and dense OpenGL ES map views, improves graphics and saves, and restores optional DXVK/Turnip rendering. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.8-dev` / code `13`, signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.7-dev:

- Enable **Fast AI turn** by default. AI estimates avoid repeatedly serializing and checksumming the map's object-name table during rollbacks. Restored entries are checked; a mismatch disables the shortcut for the process. The original path is used after the first network socket opens. Find the switch under **Settings > Additional > Controls**, between Split zones and Order confirmation. This speeds up calculations, not hero animations or AI difficulty.
- Grow the OpenGL ES upload ring when consecutive frames outgrow it, avoiding repeated per-draw allocations in dense adventure views.
- Move common DLL code into `libhomm5_common.so`, saving about 43 MB after all three engines have been unpacked. Add native vertex, lighting, battle-grid and byte-compatible deflate paths.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.7-dev
releases.body:
Adds native battle route previews, optional order confirmation and contextual alternative-attack tips, and fixes save-list refresh and repeated streaming audio. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.7-dev` / code `12`; signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.6-dev:

- Preview movement paths and destination cells before issuing a battle order. Paths follow the original prepared command, preserving obstacle detours, terrain height and flight paths. Strike and Return shows separate outgoing and returning lanes. Route previews are enabled by default and work independently of confirmation.
- Add optional battle order confirmation. Taps and gestures select movement, melee attacks, shots or spells; a separate button above the right-side action panel executes the selected order. Wait and Defend retain their immediate buttons. Confirmation is disabled by default.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.6-dev
releases.body:
Fixes Sanctuary-related AI turn stalls and improves touch controls, camera handling, interface scaling and audio buffering. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.6-dev` / code `11`; signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.5.1-dev:

- Prevent the reproduced AI turn stall with Quick Combat enabled when a hero is sheltered in a Sanctuary. Exclude that hero from quick resolution while preserving the global setting and other heroes' behavior.
- Cancel spell or creature-ability targeting with a two-finger tap, including over the interface. On the adventure map, the same gesture stops a moving hero.
- Restore the original camera with a three-finger tap in adventure, battle, deployment and town, including over the interface. Deployment accounts for the current phase and player side.
- Skip the town camera flyby with the first tap on the town view, without selecting a building.
- Show the native attack or shot icon above the damage and retaliation forecast, including when the ordinary touch cursor is disabled.
- Correct the font scale of new multiplayer-list rows after filter changes.

releases.name: Pocket2Droid v1.0.2
releases.body:
Pocket2Droid 1.0.2 adds Windows Mobile 5.0 support, Internet access and more customization.

- **Windows Mobile 5.0:** Added support for compatible Device Emulator ROM images.
- **Internet access:** Connect to the Internet inside Windows Mobile through your Android device’s connection. Internet access is enabled by default for new ROM profiles.
- **If Internet access doesn’t work:** Make sure Internet access is **On** in Pocket2Droid’s ROM settings. Inside Windows Mobile, open **Network Cards** settings and change **“My network card connects to”** from **Work** to **The Internet**. Tap **OK**, then try browsing again. Some network configurations still require manual setup, and older browsers may not support modern HTTPS websites.
- **Custom resolutions:** Set your own guest screen width and height alongside the existing presets. Compatibility varies by ROM. Custom resolutions may cause display glitches or require touchscreen recalibration inside Windows Mobile.
- **Restart option:** Restart Windows Mobile directly from the session menu.
- **Per-ROM StorageCard folders:** Choose a separate StorageCard folder for each ROM while keeping the general StorageCard folder unchanged.

releases.name: Pocket2Droid v1.0.1 — First Public Release
releases.body:
First public release of Pocket2Droid, a Windows Mobile emulator for Android that runs the complete operating system, including compatible applications and games.

### Features
- ROM library with individual settings and persistent storage.
- Shared StorageCard folder with file importing.
- On-screen controls with adjustable transparency, vibration feedback and multi-key support.
- Global button mapping for keyboards and wired/Bluetooth controllers, including sticks and triggers.
- Display scaling, orientation, screen position and fullscreen options.

### Requirements
- ARM64 Android device running Android 7.0 or newer.
- A compatible Windows Mobile `.bin` ROM.

ROMs, games and applications are not included.

### Getting started
1. Install the APK attached below.
2. Open Pocket2Droid and grant storage access.
3. Tap **+ → PPC Rom** to import your ROM.
4. Tap the ROM to start Windows Mobile.

To copy files into the guest’s storage card, use **+ → File to StorageCard**.

### Please note
- Compatibility and performance vary by device, ROM and game.

releases.body:
**New — Frame Generation (experimental)**
- **Frame Generation ships as an opt-in**: toggle it live in the Quick-Access blade (L3+R3) or per
  game in settings. It runs AMD FidelityFX optical-flow frame interpolation inside Ryudeck's own
  Vulkan present path — no external layers — presenting an interpolated frame between each pair of
  real frames on a dedicated present thread. GPU-light titles roughly double their perceived
  frame rate (measured on device: ~21-30 fps rendered → ~42-60 presented).
- It is self-limiting by design: generation only engages when it actually helps — it suspends below
  a per-title frame-rate floor, when the GPU has no spare headroom (measured from real per-frame GPU
  time, so misreported "100% busy" titles are handled), and when the game already runs near panel
  rate. A zero-delay dip veto skips generation for any single spiked frame (e.g. a shader-compile
  stall), so sudden hitches are never smeared into interpolated frames.

releases.body:
Automated build of `master` at 6c33e98bdf74755273b6e535d1c903bbe7d58508.

These are untested snapshots and may be broken. For stable builds use the [latest release](https://github.com/shanytc/snes9x/releases/latest).

**GUIs** (`super-snes9x-nightly-*`): Windows: unzip and run. Linux: `chmod +x` the AppImage. macOS: the app is universal (Intel + Apple Silicon) and self-signed, so after copying it run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine super-snes9x-qt.app`.

**libretro cores** (`supersnes9x_libretro-nightly-*`): unzip the core and its `.info` file into RetroArch's cores directory. The macOS core is a universal x86_64 + arm64 binary.

# Lua Scripting
- Added Lua 5.4 scripting: `File > Script > Lua` opens a script editor on win32, Qt and GTK, with syntax colouring, line numbers, completion, an API reference, a console and session restore.
- Added a script debugger: breakpoints (with conditions, hit counts and log messages), Step Into / Over / Out, Break on Errors, and Variables, Watch, Call Stack and Breakpoints panels.
- 28 example scripts under `Help > Examples`: FPS Counter, Sprite Boxes, RAM Heat Map, Input Display, Cheat Finder, Trace Logger and more.
- `-lua <script>` runs a script from the command line.
- `gui.set_antialias` smooths lines, circles, ellipses and polygons.
- No speed cost while no script is loaded.
- Guide and API reference: [Lua scripting](https://github.com/shanytc/snes9x/blob/master/docs/lua-scripting.md)

# Enhancement Chips (DSP-1/2/3/4, Cx4)
- DSP-1, DSP-1B, DSP-2, DSP-3, DSP-4 and the Cx4 now run as native chips that match their firmware instruction for instruction, with no dump needed.
- Each chip can also run its firmware dump (new BIOS Manager slots), or the old HLE.

# Nintendo Super System
- Added Nintendo Super System arcade support: Z80 supervisor, 
- key chip, on-screen display, three cartridge sockets and the front panel.
- Twelve of the thirteen dumped cartridges run, including HiROM and DSP-1 boards.
- Named the cartridge DIP switches for ActRaiser, The Addams Family, Lethal Weapon and Robocop 3.
- The supervisor's reset silences the APU too, Restart has to be held as on the cabinet, and nocash's test program is accepted as a BIOS.
- The joypad watchdog is off by default. Fixes Lethal Weapon being thrown off the machine.
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Nintendo Super Disc
- Added support for the BIOS in the BIOS Manager.
- Added support for disc insert and eject (eject resets to the home screen), and the disc's name in the window title.
- Working Titles:
  - Super Boss Gaiden
  - Test CD, [sdtest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32607729/sdtest.zip)
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Super Famicom Box
- The keyswitch position is remembered, and the window title names the running game.

# Super Game Boy Color (new, Experimental)
- New SGBC mode: an SGB2 with a Game Boy Color inside with customs borders support.
- This mode runs a memory patched SGB2 BIOS with per-game in-memory patch to support colors and borders.
- Color now comes from the cart instead of the stale SGB palette. 
- Pre-palette fallback goes through BGP.
- DMG-compatibility color is routed through BGP/OBP.
- Carts whose SGB detect beats the Color branch get dedicated patches.
- Note: not all games might work out of the box - some issues might occur during game play / boot.

# Super Game Boy
- MLT_REQ is latched in the ICD2 instead of waiting for the BIOS.
- BIOS mode carries its cycle remainder instead of flooring twice, and deducts GB cycle overshoot (fixes audio pacing).
- Packet bits latch on the rising edge, not the falling one.
- MASK_EN honored on the BIOS pane, LCD-off treated as a freeze.
- Boot logo held on displayed content, hidden under the SGB BIOS, and shown only when a boot ROM was actually assigned.
- GBC-only carts are no longer forced out of SGB BIOS mode on the container path.
- Sprite-limit hack offered in SGB BIOS sessions.

# Game Boy

## Voicer-kun
   - Play Voicer-kun enabled games by attaching the included audio CDs with the game (can be in cue/bin files format,  or .zip containing cue/bin);

## GB / GBC / SuperGameBoy

releases.name: Version 5.10.1
releases.body:
Changes:

* `install`, `push`: better handling for registry rate limits (HTTP 429) by honoring `Retry-After`, show detailed error when rate limit occurs while using a shared Docker Hub frontend (proxy) instead of raw `Network error: HTTP Error 429`.

Notice for users: this does not resolve issue with rate limits imposed by Docker Hub registry. Such issue just can't be resolved at proot-distro side because restriction applies to client IP address, which in case of NAT (CG-NAT) or proxy may be shared between large amount of devices.

Don't submit bug reports if encounter HTTP 429!

Workaround:

1. Create Docker Hub account.
2. Use `export PD_DOCKER_AUTH="username:password"` or `export PD_DOCKER_AUTH="username:personal-access-token"`, the personal access token must be created through account settings with permissions at least for read-only access.

releases.name: Version 5.10.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- refs: Image names are now checked using Docker's rules. Malformed names are refused with a clear message.
- install: Added support for images pinned by digest, e.g. `ubuntu@sha256:...`. The download is verified against the digest. A pinned image can be reinstalled from the cache without network.
- build, push: A digest is refused in `build -t` and `push`.
- install: Fixed intact image layers sometimes refused with "does not match its digest".
- http: Redirects can no longer move a download from HTTPS to plain HTTP. `--allow-insecure` lifts this.
- registry: `--allow-insecure` no longer applies to Docker Hub. It is always verified.
- http: Network requests give up after 2 minutes of silence instead of hanging forever.
- http: Invalid URLs and registry addresses now show an error message instead of a traceback.
- build, login: Bytes that are not valid UTF-8 in arguments, build args or image environment no longer cause a traceback.
- list, remove: `--image` no longer prints control characters from cache entries as they are.
- sync, copy: Files that change during the transfer are handled correctly. No more missed updates or wrong permissions.

releases.name: Version 5.9.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- `login`, `run`: export variables `PD_CONTAINER=<name>`, `PD_IMAGE=<image-ref>`, `PD_IMAGE_ID=<sha256-digest>` and `container=proot-distro` in sessions. Build gets same except `PD_CONTAINER`.
- `pull`: detect whether image config or manifest is shorter than `Content-Length`.
- `build` (ADD, COPY): placing directory over an existing regular file is now a refusal instead of a silent tree/layer mismatch.
- `build` (... --chmod): validate value as an octal between 0 and 07777.
- `build`: Dockerfile is read with 16 MiB limit.
- `push`: send the Bearer token on the upload PUT only when the Location URL belongs to the registry itself.
- Registry credentials are only sent to the origin they were addressed to.
- Do not carry Authorization header if host redirects from HTTPS to HTTP.
- A token endpoint realm must be `https://` (`http://` allowed under --allow-insecure). `file://`, `ftp://` and `data:` realms are refused.
- Environment strings from image config are validated before exec (no NUL, encodable, under 128 KiB).
- The `profile.d` snippet is written for every session of a normal-type container, not only default-mode Termux logins.

# Skyrim for Android 0.30.6

APK: `Skyrim-0.30.6.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).

## New
- "Disable end-of-frame image space (post-processing)" option. It does the same as the TEOFIS console command at every launch. It fixes the black world map and solid-colour underwater screen, but it also turns off all end-of-frame post-processing (tonemapping, bloom, colour grading and depth of field), so the game looks more naturally lit.
- "Asynchronous rendering" option. It's off by default and when it's on, shaders compile on background threads. New effects may pop in for a frame or two instead of causing a hitch. 

## Fixed
- Shader caching is removed. The DXVK state cache rebuilt every saved pipeline on 5 extra threads at startup, which took CPU away from the game's main thread and caused crashes on Mali devices. Nothing is cached between launches now, and the game runs better overall.
- Traps triggering freezes was due to failed lookups with vertex optimization. The function has been turned off for now.
- Audio in other languages - the decoder was reading each WMA bitstream but with the wrong block-size config. Should be working now.

# WinLite v1.4.0

## Overview
A release focused on rendering smoothness, a new X11 server and Steam support.

---

## 🎮 BETA - Steam
- Steam client support added.

---

## 🖥️ X11 server (rewritten in Rust)
The built-in X server has been rewritten from scratch in Rust and now covers much more of the X11 protocol.

**What you get**
- **Stability.** Memory-safe code removes a whole class of crashes and hangs.
- **Better game and launcher compatibility.** Newer screen-configuration (RANDR 1.2) and rendering extensions are supported, so Wine, launchers and games see a more complete environment.
- **Proper mouse cursors.** System cursors are drawn from a built-in cursor set, and colored/semi-transparent and animated cursors are supported.
- **Better frame pacing.** Frame presentation is synchronized with the real display refresh rate and with fences, which gives the renderer and the FPS limiter an accurate clock to work from.
- **Faster window drawing.** The shared frame buffer is locked once per operation instead of repeatedly, and more drawing requests (lines, rectangles, area clears) are handled directly.

This release is about speed and game compatibility. The emulation changes are listed here so you know what touches the game itself.
CPU boost and GPU boost (Settings > General > Performance). CPU boost runs the game's SSE math on your PC's processor and trims work in the CPU emulation. Per-game settings and safe mode. Each game can have its own CPU boost, GPU boost and shader seeding, used the next time it starts (Settings > General > Performance > This game). If xemu closes unexpectedly while a boost was on, that game starts in safe mode the next time, with the boosts off, and tells you. "Leave safe mode" is in the same place.

releases.body:
天玑 / MediaTek X11 专版 · 合成器测试版

本版基于 1.2.0 天玑 X11 分支，**唯一改动是打开 KWin 合成器**，用于真机验证桌面特效（窗口晃动、魔灯等）能否真正生效。

#### 本版改了什么

此前每次启动桌面会话时，脚本都会把 `kwinrc` 强制改写为：

```ini
[Compositing]
Enabled=false
Backend=QPainter
```

这正是「在系统设置里勾了窗口晃动 / 魔灯，晃了半天毫无反应」的直接原因——**合成器关着，KWin 会静默忽略全部桌面特效**。

本版改为：

```ini
[Compositing]
Enabled=true
Backend=OpenGL
GLCore=false
LatencyPolicy=Low
WindowsBlockCompositing=false
```

后端固定为 **OpenGL（硬件）**，不使用纯软件 QPainter 后端；LLVM 软件渲染（llvmpipe / swrast）在部署时仍会被删除。

#### ⚠️ 这是未经验证的测试版，请只用于测试

发布者手上没有天玑真机，**本版没有在任何天玑设备上跑过**。请把预期放低。

已知的关键疑点（在我的机器上实测发现，属于**设备无关**的问题）：

1. **guest rootfs 内缺少 `virpipe_dri.so`**。逐个列出 rootfs 中全部 Mesa DRI 驱动后确认：有 `virtio_gpu_dri.so`、`zink_dri.so`、`panfrost_dri.so`、`mediatek_dri.so`，**但没有 `virpipe_dri.so`**——而这正是 VirGL 的 guest 端驱动。会话脚本仍在强制 `GALLIUM_DRIVER=virpipe` + `VTEST_SOCKET=/tmp/.virgl_test`，即**指向一个不存在的驱动**。若真机因此拿不到 GL 上下文，合成器就起不来。

## Changes

- **Lower CPU use during races on Android.** A check the game makes very often (whenever two game threads coordinate) now skips work it had already done, so races need less of the phone's CPU. This is aimed at slower phones such as the Pixel 10a, where the CPU is the limit. On the AYN Thor the game used about 15–20% less CPU time in the middle of a race. The picture and the race are unchanged. For #176

## Validation

- **CPU time on the AYN Thor** (the middle of a Dolphin Resort race, CPU seconds the game used per second): 1.81 against 2.19 in 0.10.76 for a normal race, 1.78 against 2.18 with touch and tilt, 1.81 against 2.18 with camera motion, 2.51 against 3.15 at Race step rate 120, 1.87 against 2.20 with CPU difficulty Hard.

- **Less CPU time spent drawing each race frame.** The game's main thread now finds textures and sets them up for drawing with much less work, so busy frames with many objects on screen are less likely to run late, especially on phones that slow down when they get hot. releases.name: FableDroid 0.9.0
releases.body:
FableDroid 0.9.0: about 99% of the game's code is now decompiled to native code (59,958 of 60,481 functions: game code 99.5%, library code 98.5%). The remaining ~520 functions still run through the recompiled path and are being rewritten by hand.

### Status
- Tested on the AYN Thor (Adreno 740): boots, loads a save and plays the full forest route with no crashes.
- Performance on the Thor: the default is a locked 30 FPS (the Xbox 360's cap, steadiest). With the experimental 60 FPS setting (Settings > Frame rate) it runs about 57 FPS median, with lows around 37 FPS in heavy scenes; 40 and 60 FPS can stutter briefly while walking.
- Adreno 8xx (Odin 3, Snapdragon 8 Elite/Gen 5) and Mali are still untested on this build. Reports and logs are very welcome.

### Known issues
- The item wheel in the on-screen display occasionally draws incorrectly.

### Installing
Installs over 0.6.x as a normal update; your game files and saves are kept.

New installs: install the APK and follow the setup steps in the README. You still need your own copy of Fable II (Game of the Year edition); no game files are included.

- **Fixed: purple strip along the bottom of the screen.** Fable II clears some buffers by drawing a rectangle over them. Clears now only replace the rows they actually draw. No performance cost: still a steady 30 FPS on the Thor.

releases.body:
> **Beta.** Playable at the 30 FPS cap on the AYN Thor, with known graphics bugs and only two devices tested so far.

**Fable II, running natively on Android.** First public build of FableDroid.

**Bring your own game:** you need an ISO of a supported Fable II disc. This APK contains no game data (no art, audio, maps or video).

## Install
1. Download **FableDroid-0.6.0-beta.apk** below and open it on your device.
2. Copy your Fable II ISO to the device.
3. Open the app, tap **Select game ISO**, choose the file and wait for it to install.
4. Tap **Play**.

Requires Android 12+, 64-bit, about 7 GB free (plus the ISO while installing). An Adreno 7xx GPU (Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 or newer) is strongly recommended. On non-Adreno GPUs, choose **GPU drivers / downloads → System driver**.

## Highlights
- Native arm64 + Vulkan, 30 FPS cap held on an AYN Thor (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2) at 720p
- Low-latency mode and high tick rate on by default
- FXAA + dithered foliage instead of slow MSAA
- Install straight from the ISO on the device, one-tap save backup
- Controller remapping, touch controls with a layout editor
- Bundled Mesa Turnip driver plus a driver manager

## Supported versions
